## Design

### 2026-09-30 — This is my first Entry on Hack club so I don't really know how it works but I will try my best. On this session, I started by thinking of a good idea for a small project to start the half life program

**4h**

This is my first Entry on Hack club so I don't really know how it works but I will try my best. On this session, I started by thinking of a good idea for a small project to start the half life program. I First thought I would build something like an device that turns off your lights when it hears the voice command, but thought that was a bit too ambuish for this first project. I deciced that I would create a project that shows your current playing spotify song's album cover on the LCD screen. It would be a little desk prop you could look at while studying or to just create an nice asthetic. I already have an ESP, and wires to connect the LCD screen to the ESP,
